content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Selling digital downloads without relying on platforms like PayPal or Stripe is not just a preference; it's a necessity for many creators worldwide. Countries like Nigeria and Venezuela often face financial isolation, making conventional payment processing nearly impossible. Bitcoin payments empower creators to bypass these restrictions, allowing them to sell products directly to consumers. This infrastructure change is vital, enabling creators to retain control over their revenue while significantly reducing transaction fees—NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, unlike competitors like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture for processing Bitcoin payments for digital downloads includes several key components working in concert. Using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, alongside Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, creators can deploy an automated system that handles transactions efficiently. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the payment in real-time, confirming the transaction on-chain and triggering automated delivery of the digital product. This technical framework ensures that creators do not need to rely on centralized platforms, preserving their sovereignty over their business operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The infrastructure for Bitcoin payments is designed specifically for digital creators operating in regions with limited access to traditional financial services. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries such as Ghana, Kenya, and Zimbabwe can utilize this system to sell their digital products—whether it be ebooks, courses, or design templates—without worrying about payment rejections or high fees. By adopting this architecture, these creators take control of their financial destiny, allowing them to focus on what they do best: creating.
NOWPayments cuts fees to just 0.5%, maximizing your revenue potential.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which offer free and reliable hosting. For backend processing, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensure that logic runs efficiently and scales as needed. Supabase or Google Sheets can serve as a database for order management, with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handling file storage and delivery. The integration of NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions ties this ecosystem together, enabling immediate payment confirmation and product delivery while maintaining a low fee structure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin utilizing Bitcoin payments for your digital downloads, start by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes everything you need to launch your store within 48 hours. Set up your hosting with Cloudflare Pages and configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers. Next, integrate Supabase for order tracking and NOWPayments for payment processing. Ensure your digital products are loaded and ready for delivery. Finally, test your entire setup to confirm that transactions process smoothly before going live. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.

This infrastructure allows you to create a digital storefront that supports crypto transactions, enabling you to retain more revenue while ensuring reliable payment processing. Retain complete control over your digital products with no platform dependencies.

This post connects directly to others looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees. By using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can create a fully functional store that accepts Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for services like Gumroad or Payhip.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
